stem:
Yusuf chooses materials for a cooking pan on a flame and for its handle.

Which choices match whether easy heat flow is wanted? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Metal for the pan base, because easy heat flow from the flame to the food is wanted.
Wood for the handle, because reduced heat flow to the hand is wanted.
Metal for the handle, because reduced heat flow to the hand is wanted.
Wood for the pan base, because easy heat flow from the flame to the food is wanted.

teacher.key_rationale: Easy heat flow is wanted in the pan base, so metal fits. Reduced heat flow is wanted in the handle, so wood fits. Swapping those needs reverses the choice.
